name: Spotify → YouTube
description: Public Spotify playlists – from a username or links – played from YouTube. Write spotify-youtube as a topic in the YouTube plugin's settings and they show at the top of its front page. No login: the songs are matched to YouTube videos and kept on this server.
requires: The YouTube plugin, switched on. Internet access from the server to open.spotify.com.

settings.label: Spotify profiles
settings.help: Usernames or profile links, separated by commas. Every public playlist shown on the profile is read.

settings.label: More playlists
settings.help: Links to single public playlists, separated by commas – e.g. ones made by others.
